## Open a notebook in Google Colab

1. Follow an **Open in Colab** link from the [schedule](schedule.qmd).
2. Choose **File → Save a copy in Drive** to keep your work. You need a Google account to save a copy, but no GitHub account or local Python installation.
3. Read the instructions and run the setup cell first. Continue from top to bottom using the play button beside each code cell.
4. Follow the notebook and Canvas instructions for submitting your work.

Colab needs an internet connection. If a link does not load, check your connection and contact the instructor through Canvas.

## Course administration

**Canvas is the authoritative source** for the official syllabus, policies, assignments, submissions, deadlines, announcements, grades, and feedback. Open the course in your university Canvas account.

## About this website

The site is published with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/). Students do not need to install Quarto or use GitHub to complete course activities.
